entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Do not restore loose files which lack file-based app directives #81252
  • Error CS1744 when parameter is named `value` in extension in another project #81251
  • SdkBuild tests disabled in release/dev18.0 #81246
    18.3
  • '&method group' does not work with implicit operators of the exact unmanaged delegate type #81234

Closed

  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11213.22 #81230
  • Generate Class in new file quick fix in Shared Project shows error #36706
    Backlog
  • IntelliSense surfacing unrelated extension methods #68720
    18.3
  • Type in unimported namespace should not be preferred over type in imported namespace #42633
    18.3
  • Bad formatting on property pattern in a positional pattern when line wrapping #54434
    Backlog
  • New Document outline in VS2022 17.4 - font too small #72172
    Backlog
  • Wrong behavior when using records with primary constructors and inheritance? #48243
  • CA2208 breaks paramrefs with C# 14 extension blocks #81225
  • IntelliSense should filter attributes to only those that apply #7640
    Backlog
  • Syntax highlight problem - generic Dictionary #81206
  • Automatic curly braces aren't always added in interpolated strings #55091
    Backlog
  • Multiple patterns inside parens don't format correctly #78449
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix IDE0065 corrupting code when moving usings with preprocessor directives #81250
    VSCode
  • Fix "Invert if" losing indentation on multi-line conditions #81249
    VSCode
  • Fix completion to show both property and extension method with same name #81248
    VSCode
  • Remove hard selection for required members in object initializers #81247
    VSCode
  • [release/dev18.0] Fix build task integration tests #81245
  • Add name completion for Func<..., T> with Factory and Selector suffixes #81244
    VSCode
  • Add colorization for array, pointer, and function pointer type aliases #81243
    VSCode
  • Fix parenthesis brace completion for nested invocations in control flow statements #81242
    VSCode
  • Unsafe evolution: require unsafe for some pointer operations #81240
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Add 'add extension completion' support for modern extensions. #81239
    Area-IDE, Feature - Extension Everything, VSCode
  • Investigate IDE0055 ternary operator formatting issue and add test coverage #81238
    VSCode
  • Use work done progress to handle restore server side #81233
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
  • Improve error recovery for incomplete attribute in a type-parameter. #81231
    Area-IDE, Area-Compilers, VSCode

Merged

  • Disable AzDO dependabot #81241
    Area-IDE, Next
  • [release/dev18.0] Update MSBuild packages in net472 to 18.0.2 #81228
  • Fix property pattern indentation in positional and parenthesized patterns #81199
    VSCode, Next
  • Update solution explorer font automatically when user changes it #81237
    Area-IDE, Needs UX Triage, Next
  • Improve error message for record inheritance without parameter list #80795
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Filter IntelliSense attribute suggestions by AttributeTargets #81157
    Area-Compilers, VSCode, Next
  • [release/dev17.11] Pull publish data directly from branch #81235
  • Include default RSP files for core compilers #80993
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • [release/dev17.8] Backport publish data to 17.10 #81236
  • [release/dev17.11] Add monthly smoke test to release branch official builds #81098
  • Remove MSBuild dependencies from BuidlHost deps.json #80957
  • Fix CG issue for Microsoft.IO.Redist #81223
  • Remove MSBuild dependencies from BuidlHost deps.json #80959
    VSCode
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #81232
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Update MSBuild packages in net472 to 18.0.2 #81226
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Add indentation for parenthesized patterns with multiple patterns #81201
    VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Add timing telemetry for source generator table transform operations #81028
  • Add initial support for Union matching #81188
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Unions
  • Allow using DartLab for VS release build validation #81155
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add IOp support for `with(...)` elements. #81058
    Area-Compilers, Needs UX Triage, Needs API Review, VSCode, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Avoid premature full binding of a receiver as a value in the process of binding possible type-or-value receiver (so-called “Color Color” scenario) #80978
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix AbstractSemanticQuickInfoSourceTests.AssertTaggedText to respect expectedClassifications parameter #80785
  • Do not copy hoisted locals or parameters unnecessarily #81227
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • Update Azure pipeline queue names from vs2022 to vs2026 #80782
  • Update to .NET 10.0.100 RTM #81229
  • Feature/81141 enhance properties on top level #81221
    Area-Compilers, Community
